class.name: OcgGraphic3dTextureset
class.brief_description: Class holding array of textures to be mapped as a set. Textures should be defined in ascending order of texture units within the set.
class.description: ! Class holding array of textures to be mapped as a set. ! Textures should be defined in ascending order of texture units within the set.
